requirements.title: Component naming and definition
requirements.spec_says: Component MUST be named ExtentManager with receptacles metadata_device: IBlockDevice and logger: ILogger
requirements.code_does: define_component! with ExtentManager, IExtentManager, metadata_device, logger

requirements.title: FormatParams validation
requirements.spec_says: format() MUST validate all FormatParams fields
requirements.code_does: Validates sector_size > 0, slab_size multiple, max_extent_size <= slab_size, region_count power-of-two, metadata device large enough

requirements.title: Superblock write at LBA 0
requirements.spec_says: format() MUST write superblock at LBA 0 with CRC32
requirements.code_does: Superblock serialized with CRC32 and written to LBA 0

requirements.title: initialize() reads and validates superblock
requirements.spec_says: initialize() MUST read superblock, validate magic/CRC, recover from active checkpoint, rebuild state
requirements.code_does: Recovery reads superblock, validates magic+CRC, recovers checkpoint, rebuilds regions/buddies/bitmaps

requirements.title: reserve_extent returns WriteHandle
requirements.spec_says: reserve_extent MUST allocate sector-aligned slot, return WriteHandle, not visible until publish
requirements.code_does: Allocates via region, sector-aligns size, returns WriteHandle with publish/abort closures

requirements.title: FREE_KEY publish is silent discard
requirements.spec_says: If key equals FREE_KEY, slot MUST be freed, call returns Ok, no visibility
requirements.code_does: publish_fn checks key == FREE_KEY, calls free_slot, returns Ok(Extent)

requirements.title: Abort/drop releases slot
requirements.spec_says: abort() or drop MUST release slot without writing key
requirements.code_does: WriteHandle::abort() and Drop impl call abort_fn which frees the slot

requirements.title: remove_extent with deferred free
requirements.spec_says: remove_extent sets key to FREE_KEY, hides from enumeration, slot freed after checkpoint
requirements.code_does: Sets key to FREE_KEY, adds to pending_frees, flush_pending_frees after checkpoint; OffsetNotFound returned for invalid

requirements.title: Enumeration filters FREE_KEY
requirements.spec_says: get_extents returns all non-FREE_KEY; for_each_extent invokes callback for each
requirements.code_does: Both methods iterate slabs, filter key != FREE_KEY

requirements.title: Per-slab key vectors
requirements.spec_says: Each Slab MUST maintain dense Vec<u64> parallel to bitmap
requirements.code_does: Slab struct has keys: Vec<u64> initialized to FREE_KEY, no separate HashMap

requirements.title: FREE_KEY sentinel
requirements.spec_says: FREE_KEY = u64::MAX marks unoccupied slots
requirements.code_does: pub const FREE_KEY: u64 = u64::MAX

requirements.title: BTreeMap keyed by start_offset
requirements.spec_says: Slabs in BTreeMap<u64, Slab> with range(..=offset).next_back() for O(log n)
requirements.code_does: slabs: BTreeMap<u64, Slab> in RegionState; remove uses range(..=offset).next_back()

requirements.title: Checkpoint serialization with CRC32
requirements.spec_says: checkpoint MUST serialize regions with CRC32, write to inactive, switch superblock
requirements.code_does: write_checkpoint serializes all regions, builds CRC32 header+payload, writes inactive, updates active_copy

requirements.title: Skip checkpoint when clean
requirements.spec_says: checkpoint MUST skip I/O if no region modified
requirements.code_does: run_checkpoint checks any_dirty, returns Ok early if all clean

requirements.title: Checkpoint coalescing
requirements.spec_says: Concurrent calls coalesced; at most two active checkpoint I/O operations
requirements.code_does: CheckpointCoalesce with in_progress/completed_seq; waiters compute needed = seq+2 max, block on condvar

requirements.title: Background checkpoint thread default interval
requirements.spec_says: Background thread MUST call checkpoint at configurable interval (default 300 seconds / 5 minutes)
requirements.code_does: Default interval is Duration::from_secs(30) (30 seconds) in new_inner()
requirements.impact: Systems using default will checkpoint 10x more frequently than spec states; increased metadata write amplification

requirements.title: Dual-copy fallback recovery
requirements.spec_says: Recovery MUST try active first, fall back to inactive on failure
requirements.code_does: recover() tries active_offset, on error tries inactive with prev_seq

requirements.title: Recovery rebuilds from key vectors
requirements.spec_says: initialize MUST restore extents by reading key vectors, marking non-FREE slots allocated
requirements.code_does: slab_from_descriptor iterates keys, marks allocated for non-FREE entries

requirements.title: Buddy allocator per region
requirements.spec_says: Each region MUST use buddy allocator for slab-sized chunks
requirements.code_does: BuddyAllocator per RegionState with alloc/free/mark_allocated

requirements.title: Bitmap allocator with rover
requirements.spec_says: Each slab MUST use bitmap allocator with rover
requirements.code_does: AllocationBitmap with find_free_from(rover); rover wraps on alloc

requirements.title: Size-class manager
requirements.spec_says: Size-class manager MUST index slabs by element size for O(1) lookup
requirements.code_does: SizeClassManager with HashMap<u32, Vec<u64>>

requirements.title: Key sharding
requirements.spec_says: Keys sharded by key & (region_count - 1)
requirements.code_does: let idx = key as usize & (regions.len() - 1)

requirements.title: Independent region locking
requirements.spec_says: Each region independently locked with parking_lot::RwLock; hot-path only acquires target
requirements.code_does: Vec<Arc<RwLock<RegionState>>> with parking_lot::RwLock; reserve_extent touches only outer read + target write

requirements.title: Send + Sync
requirements.spec_says: Component MUST be Send + Sync
requirements.code_does: Implicitly Send+Sync via Arc/Mutex/RwLock composition; concurrent tests validate

requirements.title: Deferred free crash safety
requirements.spec_says: Freed slot MUST NOT be reallocated until checkpoint persists removal
requirements.code_does: pending_frees accumulates removals; flush_pending_frees called only after successful checkpoint

requirements.title: get_instance_id
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide get_instance_id() returning superblock instance_id
requirements.code_does: fn get_instance_id() reads shared.superblock.instance_id

requirements.title: set_checkpoint_interval
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide set_checkpoint_interval(duration)
requirements.code_does: On IExtentManager trait; delegates to CheckpointTimerState

requirements.title: set_metadata_ns_id
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide set_metadata_ns_id(ns_id: u32)
requirements.code_does: pub fn set_metadata_ns_id on concrete ExtentManager type

requirements.title: set_dma_alloc
requirements.spec_says: MUST provide set_dma_alloc(alloc)
requirements.code_does: pub fn set_dma_alloc on concrete ExtentManager type

requirements.title: volatile_write_cache feature gate
requirements.spec_says: MAY support volatile_write_cache controlling flush calls
requirements.code_does: Feature in Cargo.toml; cfg guards on flush calls in checkpoint and superblock write

requirements.title: used_bytes()
requirements.spec_says: used_bytes() returns total bytes currently allocated (sum of all published extent sizes)
requirements.code_does: Returns buddy total_usable_size - total_free, which is slab-level allocation not per-extent sum
requirements.impact: Reports slab-granularity usage; a 1GiB slab with one 4KiB extent reports 1GiB used

requirements.title: capacity_bytes()
requirements.spec_says: capacity_bytes() returns total data device capacity
requirements.code_does: Sums buddy.total_usable_size() across all regions

requirements.title: WriteHandle in interfaces crate
requirements.spec_says: WriteHandle MUST be defined in interfaces crate with RAII semantics
requirements.code_does: WriteHandle struct in interfaces/src/iextent_manager.rs with publish/abort/Drop

requirements.title: Fault injection test infrastructure
requirements.spec_says: Fault injection behind a 'test-only' feature gate
requirements.code_does: Feature gate named 'testing' (not 'test-only'); full FaultConfig/MockBlockDevice implemented
requirements.impact: Feature gate naming inconsistency only; functionality is complete

requirements.title: On-disk superblock format
requirements.spec_says: Magic 0x4345_5254_5553_5635 (CERTUSV5), version 5, CRC at offset 84, no data_start_offset field
requirements.code_does: Magic 0x4345_5254_5553_5634 (CERTUSV4), FORMAT_VERSION=6, data_start_offset at offset 84 (8 bytes), CRC at offset 92
requirements.impact: Any tool using spec's documented binary layout will misparse. Magic, version, and field offsets all differ.

requirements.title: 100M extent scale validation
requirements.spec_says: Component supports ~100 million extents on 10 TB data device
requirements.code_does: No test validates this scale; largest test uses ~800 extents
requirements.impact: Scalability claim is architecturally plausible but unverified

not_implemented.title: Compile-time Send+Sync assertion
not_implemented.description: No static assertion guaranteeing Send+Sync. Component is Send+Sync via field composition, but a future refactor could silently break this.

not_implemented.title: BlockDeviceClient::flush() for volatile_write_cache
not_implemented.description: The volatile_write_cache feature gates calls to metadata_client.flush() but no flush() method exists in block_io.rs. Feature may not compile when enabled.

unspecified_code.description: Enables metadata and data coexistence on same NVMe device by recording where data begins after metadata reservation
Caps metadata area size (default 128 MiB) so metadata+data can share a single SSD. Not listed in spec's FormatParams entity.

recommendations.action: Update spec superblock on-disk format to match implementation: magic 0x4345_5254_5553_5634, version 6, add data_start_offset field at offset 84, CRC at offset 92
Reconcile default checkpoint interval: spec says 300s, code uses 30s. Update spec to 30s or provide rationale for either value.
Add large-scale benchmark for SC-005 validating memory and performance at 100M extent count
Add metadata_region_size and data_start_offset to spec FormatParams and superblock layout
Align feature gate name: rename spec 'test-only' to 'testing' or rename code feature to 'test-only'
Clarify used_bytes() semantics in spec to match slab-level implementation or change code to sum actual extent sizes
Add static_assertions::assert_impl_all!(ExtentManager: Send, Sync) for compile-time safety
Verify volatile_write_cache feature compiles by implementing BlockDeviceClient::flush() or confirming it is gated out
